description: Tapping a grid photo opens a full-screen lightbox that behaves like the photo apps Guests already know. yet-another-react-lightbox loads via dynamic import only on first open. Gestures: swipe left/right between photos with visible arrow fallback, swipe down to dismiss, pinch to zoom (page zoom stays enabled), single tap toggles chrome. Back button contract, hand-written: opening pushes exactly one history entry, popstate/back closes the lightbox and restores grid scroll position, photo navigation never pushes entries. Accessibility: focus trap with focus returned to the opening thumbnail, Escape closes, arrow keys navigate, prefers-reduced-motion honored. Styled exclusively through Theme tokens over the library's CSS custom properties.
title: Lightbox island: full-screen photo viewing with native-feeling gestures
acceptance_criteria: The lightbox bundle loads only when a Guest opens a photo (dynamic import), not on page load
Opening pushes exactly one history entry; back/popstate closes the lightbox and never exits the page; photo navigation pushes no entries — covered by a component test
Swipe between photos, swipe-down dismiss, and pinch-zoom work on a real phone; visible arrows work everywhere
Keyboard-only flow completes: open, navigate, close with focus returned to the opening thumbnail
All lightbox chrome colors come from Theme tokens via the library's CSS variables
